On October 22, 2026, C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc. (the "Company") entered into a Fifth Amendment (the "Amendment") to its Credit Agreement, dated as of October 29, 2012 (as previously amended, the "Credit Agreement"). The parties to the Amendment are the Company, the guarantors party thereto, the lenders party thereto constituting the Required Lenders, and U.S. Bank National Association, as administrative agent. The Amendment, among other things, permits the Company's previously announced acquisition of RXO, Inc. ("RXO") under the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of October 4, 2026 (the "RXO Acquisition"), and the related financing transactions. It also provides that the RXO Acquisition will be a "Permitted Acquisition" and a "Material Acquisition" under the Credit Agreement, amends the pro forma calculation of Consolidated EBITDA for Material Acquisitions, including the RXO Acquisition, so that it is based on the historical financial statements of the acquired business, and revises the net leverage covenant (which remains a maximum Net Leverage Ratio of 3.75 to 1.00) to eliminate the cap on cash netting. It also provides that a Leverage Holiday will be deemed elected upon completion of the RXO Acquisition and will count as one of the two permitted Leverage Holidays. The foregoing description of the Amendment is a summary and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Amendment, which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference. Furnished herewith as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, respectively, and incorporated by reference herein are the text of the Company's announcement regarding its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and its earnings conference call slides.
